name: Paddy Field
description: Paddy Field, located in the lush tea estates of Vavuniya, offers visitors a unique glimpse into the rural life of Sri Lanka. Historically, these fields were once part of extensive paddy cultivation before the rise of tea plantations. Today, they serve as a tranquil backdrop for nature lovers and photographers, allowing them to capture the serene beauty of the land. Walking through these fields provides a peaceful escape from the hustle of urban life, connecting tourists with the rich agricultural heritage of the region.
